Our client, OSMO Creations, transforms ideas into impactful outcomes through design, storytelling, and innovation. As a multidisciplinary creative studio based in Australia, they operate at the crossroads of strategy, design, and technology. From their headquarters in Para Hills West, South Australia, they bring together Designers, Producers, Filmmakers, and digital specialists to deliver outstanding, integrated solutions.

They are now looking for a Digital Production Manager to join their creative team. In this role, you will act as the vital link between creative vision and seamless delivery, managing the end-to-end production of digital content assets, including video, motion graphics, and interactive experiences, while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with brand standards.

The annual salary for the Digital Production Manager is $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Duties include:

•	Lead project planning: scope, timeline, resource allocation, budget.

•	Liaise with creative teams (Designers, Editors, Animators, Developers) to ensure deliverables meet the creative brief.

•	Manage production workflows: pre-production, shoot/asset capture, post-production, delivery.

•	Maintain high-quality standards and brand consistency across all outputs.

•	Anticipate and resolve production risks and bottlenecks.

•	Track project metrics and provide status updates to stakeholders.

•	Continuously optimise production processes for efficiency and scalability.

•	Collaborate closely with clients and account teams to interpret creative briefs and translate them into actionable production plans.

•	Oversee vendor relationships, including freelance creatives, post-production partners, and technical suppliers, ensuring deliverables meet OSMO’s standards.

•	Implement and maintain digital asset management systems and file-naming conventions to streamline workflow and ensure version control.

•	Drive innovation in production processes by exploring new tools, software, and emerging technologies that enhance creativity and efficiency.

•	Support business development by providing production insights, timelines, and cost estimates during pitches and proposal stages.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least two (2) years of relevant experience.

•	Should hold at least an AQF Bachelor or higher qualification, or equivalent qualifications and have at least 2 years of recent and relevant work experience; or 5 years of relevant work experience may substitute for a qualification.

•	Should have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; or have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience.

Our reputation has been built on technical excellence, attention to detail and seamless collaboration with architects, developers, builders and consultants. Our mission is to provide practical, efficient and innovative engineering solutions that stand the test of time.

## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure

result.description:
Full-time ICT Business Analyst position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Altona North, VIC 3025. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time ICT Business Analyst
•	$80,000 p.a. plus superannuation 
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
HYDAC Pty Ltd - HYDAC is a global provider of hydraulics, filtration and fluid technology solutions serving industrial sectors worldwide.
As an ICT Business Analyst at HYDAC Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing business requirements and improving the digital systems that support engineering, sales, inventory, service and operational workflows. This position requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement and the ability to translate operational needs into practical ICT solutions.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Work with users across engineering, sales, supply chain, service, finance and administration to formulate and document business and ICT requirements.
•	Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices supporting HYDAC's hydraulic, filtration and fluid technology operations.
•	Identify system inefficiencies, deficiencies and limitations, and recommend improved business practices, system functionality and workflow behaviour.
•	Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop plans and assist with the costing, resourcing and delivery of ICT improvement projects.
•	Develop functional specifications for system developers, technology vendors and integration partners.
•	Use data and process modelling techniques to prepare clear system specifications for enterprise applications, reporting tools and system integrations.
•	Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including preparing and implementing system test plans to ensure acceptable quality, integrity and performance.
•	Create user guides, process documentation and training materials, and deliver training to employees using new or updated systems.
•	Act as a central reference point for ICT projects, providing guidance and information to support system proposals, priorities and decision-making.
•	Facilitate stakeholder workshops and interviews, maintain requirements traceability, and manage changes to agreed business and system requirements.
•	Coordinate system upgrades, integrations and releases with internal teams and external providers, supporting user acceptance testing, rollout and issue resolution.
•	Monitor post-implementation outcomes, analyse system performance and user feedback, and recommend continuous improvements to digital workflows and reporting.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an ICT Business Analyst
•	Strong business process analysis, requirements gathering and documentation skills
•	Experience with process mapping, data modelling and functional specification development
•	Ability to analyse and improve enterprise systems, integrations and reporting workflows
•	Strong stakeholder communication, workshop facilitation, problem-solving and project coordination skills

Salary: The role offers a remuneration package of $80,000 p.a plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.
